skills.name: Empty Void (空亡)
skills.description: Tsukuyomi strikes a single target with the power of lies, dealing damage equal to 100% of their ATK. ; Illusory Moon (虚偽の月) :Immune to debuffs and control effects. Inherits 45% of Tsukuyomi's HP, 100% of their DEF, and 100% of their SPD. When it takes an action, inflicts all enemies with 2 stacks of Lost Star. Reduces its redirected damage received and AOE damage received by 50%. When it takes lethal damage, it is KO'd after the attacker takes an action. When the Illusory Moon is present, Tsukuyomi ignores 100 DEF when attacking monsters. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 125% and if the Illusory Moon is present, restores 10% of Tsukuyomi's HP.

skills.name: Illusory Moonfall (虚誕月落)
skills.line: The stars are now in place and the illusory moon will fall again.
skills.description: There's a fine line between illusion and reality, friend and foe. Tsukuyomi conjures the Illusory Moon. While the Illusory Moon is present and when an enemy use a normal attack or single target special skill to attack an ally, there is a 40% chance of the damage and accompanying debuffs or control effects to be redirected to the Illusory Moon; when an enemy uses a normal attack or single target special skill and and fails to deal damage, there is also a 40% chance of its debuffs or control effects to be redirected to the Illusory Moon. ; : ; Illusory Moon (虚偽の月) :Immune to debuffs and control effects. Inherits 45% of Tsukuyomi's HP, 100% of their DEF, and 100% of their SPD. When it takes an action, inflicts all enemies with 2 stacks of Lost Star. Reduces its redirected damage received and AOE damage received by 50%. When it takes lethal damage, it is KO'd after the attacker takes an action. When the Illusory Moon is present, Tsukuyomi ignores 100 DEF when attacking monsters. :''(Uses ally summon spot.)''

upgrades.text: Chance increases to 70%. For every 30% of Illusory Moon's max HP, the chance increases by an additional 10%.
'''Exclusive effect''': At the end of a non-summoned enemy's turn, increases Tsukuyomi's move bar by 10% until the Illusory Moon is conjured for the first time.

skills.name: Moon Collapsed (月烬天極/月燼天極)
skills.line: Sleep now. This is the truth prepared especially for you.
skills.description: The ashes of lies fall from the sky. Tsukuyomi launches a 4-strike attack on all enemies, dealing damage equal to 44% of their ATK with each strike. Also inflicts 1 stack of Lost Star on a targeted enemy. ;Lost Star (惑星) : :'''Debuff, Mark''': Max of 5 stacks. After a target with Lost Star is attacked, detonates it and removes 1 stack, dealing damage equal to 55% of Tsukuyomi's ATK and restoring 5% of Illusory Moon's max HP, does not trigger the enemy's soul effects. Damage increases to 85% when attacking monsters. Triggers once per turn. When Tsukuyomi attacks an enemy with 2 or more Lost Star stacks, detonates it at the end of Tsukuyomi's turn and removes 3 Lost Star stacks.

upgrades.text: Damage increases to 56% and the number of Lost Star stacks inflicted increases to 2.
